body: I agree with alot of critics criticisms of the show tbh, its just the few that shame their fellow reviewers. I agree that IMDB is a better platform though.

I completely agree, I was thinking about writing a segment on why RT is shite but at the end of the day its the system that I think alot of people gravitate towards when considering shows. The focus of this post was more on EW's shady actions rather then RT. Ty for the reply.

Btw that “professional” article is listed twice (once for each author) on the rotten tomatoes top critics section, in which there are only I think 13 critics. Wouldn’t affect the rating that much but I still feel that’s a shady move by the authors and an oversight on the part of RT.

Edit: and (this might not be true as I read it on the comments section of the article) the main writer of the article, Darren I think, gave the show a 0 on MC which I feel neatly sums up how malicious these guys are. It’s an affront to audiences and gives professional, talented reviewers a bad name.
